verdict.rationale: Speechmatics is a SaaS speech API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair axis. The evidence pack never documents a sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production environment. Project-scoped API keys, free trial credits, temporary keys, and self-hosted deployment are adjacent features, not a product-provided sandbox, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
